description: Decode Modbus, CAN, UDS, CoAP and MAVLink frames field by field, watch live traffic, save it for Wireshark, and browse the IoTCom.Net protocols — powered by the iotcom CLI.
container.title: IoTCom.Net
welcome.protocols:
Connecting to the iotcom CLI…
Install it with `dotnet tool install -g IoTCom.Net.Cli --prerelease`, or set **iotcom.cliPath**.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22iotcom.cliPath%22)
config.cliPath: Command that runs the iotcom CLI, e.g. `iotcom` (global tool) or `dotnet /path/to/iotcom.dll`. Empty: the global tool, or the CLI built in this workspace.
config.docsLanguage: Language of the documentation links. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
